The **Gulper Smacker** is a two-handed melee weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Test Your Metal* update. It is acquired by completing Event: Moonshine Jamboree.

A sturdy oar that is surprisingly effective at dealing with giant, irradiated salamanders. It is highly customizable.

The Gulper Smacker has several mod slots and may be equipped with Legendary Mods. The oar head may be modified to deal extra damage, apply bleed effects, or penetrate armor. The severed hand of an acid gulper may be strapped to the shaft to apply poison damage. While some mods are unlocked automatically, others will require learning a plan in order to be crafted. Modifying the Gulper Smacker may require the Makeshift Warrior perk at rank 2 or 3 to be equipped.

Once Plan: Gulper Smacker has been read, the Gulper Smacker may be crafted at any weapons workbench under the Blunt Melee Weapons category. It is available for levels 20, 30, 40, and 50 and costs a handful of Screws, Steel, and Wood.

**Repairing**

The Gulper Smacker may be repaired at any Weapons Workbench in exchange for Scrap. Alternatively, it may be repaired by examining the item and using a Basic Repair Kit or Improved Repair Kit.

| Materials: | | Produces: | 
| Gulper Smacker (1) | | Adhesive (1) Screw (1) Steel (1) Wood (4) | 

**Scrapping**

The Gulper Smacker may be dismantled for Scrap at most workbenches.
